# Advanced Business Analytics System - Predictive Insights Report
*Auto-generated by `run_pipeline.py` on 06 Oct 2026. Data: Jan 2020 - Dec 2023, 40 stores.*

## 1. Executive summary
* 2023 chain sales were **₹29.34 Cr** (+6.2% vs previous year).
* Promotion days sell **+36%** more per store-day than non-promo days.
* The best model (Gradient boosting (tuned)) forecasts store sales 28 days ahead with **6.7% MAPE** (R² 0.97), cutting MAE by **57%** versus the seasonal-naive baseline.
* Expected chain sales for the next 28 days: **₹2.17 Cr**.
* 22% of customers churned; the churn model flags **1,355 high-risk customers** carrying ₹84.48 L of 12-month spend.

## 2. Data preparation
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Raw store-day rows | 58,480 |
| Duplicate store-days removed | 40 |
| Negative sales set to missing | 12 |
| Keying-error outliers (> 4x rolling median) removed | 25 |
| Missing sales imputed (per-store interpolation) | 387 |
| Missing temperature imputed | 1168 |
| Clean rows | 58,440 |

Feature engineering: calendar (weekday, month, week, cyclical day-of-year), holiday proximity, promo flag, temperature, store attributes, lags (28/35/42/364 days) and rolling mean/std computed on data at least 28 days old, so the model only uses information available when the forecast is made.

## 3. Sales forecasting (test = year 2023, train = earlier years, time-ordered split)
|                                          |     MAE |    RMSE |   MAPE_% |    R2 |
|:-----------------------------------------|--------:|--------:|---------:|------:|
| Seasonal naive (same weekday, 4 wks ago) | 3248.16 | 5269.9  |   15.448 | 0.838 |
| Ridge regression                         | 1969.77 | 2880.8  |    9.539 | 0.952 |
| Gradient boosting (tuned)                | 1384.65 | 2141.48 |    6.729 | 0.973 |

Best hyper-parameters: `{'regressor__learning_rate': 0.1, 'regressor__max_iter': 300, 'regressor__max_leaf_nodes': 31}`. Top drivers: lag_28, store_id, promo, lag_35, dow.

## 4. KPIs (2023)
* Best store by sales per sq ft: **S23** (Express, East) at ₹1,367; weakest: **S03** (Express, South) at ₹790.
* Top region: **South** (37% of sales). Store types: Express 13%, High Street 39%, Mall 48%.
* Footfall-to-transaction conversion: 34%.

## 5. Customer behaviour
### Churn prediction (hold-out 25%, 3,750 customers; threshold 0.35)
|                     |   ROC-AUC |   Precision |   Recall |    F1 |
|:--------------------|----------:|------------:|---------:|------:|
| Logistic regression |     0.774 |       0.535 |    0.436 | 0.481 |
| Gradient boosting   |     0.761 |       0.538 |    0.422 | 0.473 |

Selected production model: **Logistic regression** (highest ROC-AUC).

Top-decile lift: the 10% highest-scored customers churn **2.8x** more often than average. Main drivers: recency_days, loyalty_member, complaints_12m, n_categories.

## 6. Predictive recommendations
1. **Inventory & staffing:** use the 28-day store-level forecast (`outputs/forecast_next_28d.csv`) for replenishment and rostering; peak days follow weekends, promo windows and festivals.
2. **Promotions:** with a +36% lift, concentrate campaigns on weak-performing stores (S03 and similar) and avoid discounting already high-demand festival days.
3. **Retention:** launch win-back offers for the 1,355 high-risk customers, starting with the highest-spend ones (`outputs/customers_scored.csv`).
4. **Segments:** protect "High-value regulars" with loyalty benefits; grow basket size of "Low-spend occasional" shoppers with cross-sell bundles and targeted, margin-aware coupons.
5. **Store performance:** investigate the bottom-5 stores by sales per sq ft (layout, assortment, local competition) and replicate practices from the top stores.
6. **Retraining:** re-run `python run_pipeline.py` weekly (a GitHub Actions workflow is included) to refresh data, models, dashboard and this report.

## 7. Limitations
Data is synthetic (see `src/data_generation.py`); metrics demonstrate the methodology, not real-world accuracy. Future promotions are assumed to follow the chain-wide campaign calendar; store-specific promos are unknown in advance.
